People are asked how they can disbelieve in Allah, who gave them life, will cause them to die and revive them, and created the earth and the seven heavens.
All in the heavens and earth belongs to Allah, who will bring people to account for what they show or conceal, forgiving or punishing whom He wills.
Allah, there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
Nothing on earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah, who forms people in the wombs as He wills; there is no deity except Him.
Allah, Owner of sovereignty, gives and takes kingship, honors and humbles, merges night and day, brings the living from the dead and provides without account.
To Allah belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and to Him all matters return.
To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and He is competent over all things.
To Allah belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and He encompasses all things.
To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth; He punishes and forgives whom He wills and is competent over all things.
To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth and all within them, and He is competent over all things.
Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Allah; He has decreed mercy upon Himself, will assemble all on the Day of Resurrection, and hears and knows all.
If Allah's punishment or the Hour came, people would invoke Him alone, and He would remove it if He willed, while they forget what they associated with Him.
If Allah took away hearing and sight and sealed hearts, no other deity could restore them; and if His punishment came, only the wrongdoing people would be destroyed.
Allah alone rescues people from the darknesses of land and sea, yet they associate others; He can send affliction from above or below or confuse them into sects.
Allah created the heavens and earth in truth; when He says Be, it is, His is the dominion on the Day the Horn is blown, and He knows the unseen.
Allah is free of need and merciful, able to replace people with others; what is promised is coming, and the wrongdoers will not succeed.
To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death, and besides Him there is no protector or helper.
Do not be grieved by their speech, for all honor belongs to Allah and all in the heavens and earth are His; those who invoke 'partners' follow only assumption.
Angels guard each person by Allah's decree; He does not change a people's condition until they change themselves; He shows lightning, raises clouds and strikes with thunderbolts whom He wills.
The Prophet's duty is only to convey, and the account is Allah's; He reduces the land from its borders, none can adjust His decision, and all planning belongs to Him.
Allah gives life and causes death and is the Inheritor; He knows the earlier and the later generations and will gather them all.
Allah creates people and then takes them in death, and some are returned to a decrepit old age, knowing nothing after having known.
Allah owns the unseen of the heavens and earth; the command of the Hour is but a glance of the eye or nearer, for He is competent over all things.
Asked who owns the earth, who is Lord of the seven heavens and the Great Throne, and who holds the realm of all things, they answer Allah, yet are deluded.
Asked who created the heavens and earth, subjected the sun and moon and sends rain, they say Allah, yet they are deluded; He extends or restricts provision as He wills.
All in the heavens and earth belong to Allah and obey Him; He begins creation and repeats it, which is easier for Him, and His is the highest attribute.
Asked who created the heavens and earth, they would say Allah, though most do not know; all in the heavens and earth is His, the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth, made winged angels messengers and adds to creation as He wills; none can withhold the mercy He grants or release what He withholds.
People need Allah while He is Free of need and Praiseworthy, and if He willed He could remove them and bring a new creation, which is not difficult for Him.
Allah holds the heavens and earth from ceasing, and if they ceased no one after Him could hold them.
Had Allah willed, He could have obliterated their eyes so they could not find the path, or deformed them in their places so they could neither go forward nor return.
Allah is the Creator and Disposer of all things and holds the keys of the heavens and earth, and those who disbelieve in His verses are the losers.
The Creator of the heavens and earth made mates for people and cattle; nothing is like Him, and He holds their keys, extending or restricting provision.
Allah is Subtle with His servants, provides for whom He wills, and is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth; He gives daughters or sons or both to whom He wills, and makes whom He wills barren.
To Allah is the final return; He makes people laugh and weep, gives death and life, creates male and female from a sperm-drop, enriches, and is Lord of Sirius.
Allah created all things with predestination, His command is done like a glance of the eye, and He has already destroyed your kinds.
All in the heavens and earth ask of Him, and every day He is bringing about a matter.
All in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, who holds their dominion, gives life and death, created them in six days, knows all things and merges night and day.
Allah made the earth easy to walk and eat from; none is safe from Him making it swallow them or sending a storm of stones, as earlier deniers found.
Allah's vengeance is severe; He originates and repeats, and He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate, the honorable Owner of the Throne, doing whatever He intends.
